name: h3.c
tagline: A from-scratch MiniMax H3 inference engine for Mac in pure C, from the creator of Redis
description: h3.c is a from-scratch implementation of a MiniMax H3 inference engine for Apple Silicon Macs, written in pure C. It is a minimalist systems-code masterclass from antirez, the creator of Redis, who distills the whole inference pipeline into clean, dependency-free C. With 1.7k stars in four days and 438 points on Hacker News, it has become the go-to reference for running the H3 model locally on a Mac.
highlights: From the creator of Redis, Salvatore Sanfilippo (antirez)
Runs MiniMax H3 inference on Apple Silicon in pure, dependency-free C
Minimalist systems programming as a teaching artifact
1.7k stars in four days with 438 Hacker News points
A rare look at how a legend of systems code approaches LLM inference
curatorNote: When the Redis creator writes a from-scratch inference engine in clean C, you stop and read it. Both a working H3 runner for Macs and a masterclass in how minimal inference code can really be — 438 HN points says it all.
